newsitem.title: INDIA: Canada's Excel to launch Indian offshore fund.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Excel to launch Indian offshore fund.

text.p: Canadian asset management firm Excel Funds Management will launch an Indian equities fund for retail and institutional Canadian investors next month, managers to the fund, Birla Capital AMC said on Thursday.
Though the open-ended fund does not have an official target, it expects to collect between 25-50 million Canadian dollars, R. Murthy, chief executive officer of Birla Capital AMC told Reuters.
"Ninety percent of the amount collected will be invested in Indian equities while the remaining 10 percent will be invested in Canadian companies having a tie-up with Indian ventures," Murthy said.
He said the fund would be registered in the three states of Ontario, Quebec and Alberta.
Birla Capital AMC -- a venture with the U.S.-based Capital International -- manages assets totalling around 3.5 billion rupees.
